criteria.description: Leads with Not ready because the migration changes every existing project and conflicts with restoration.
Discovers that NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP backfills archived_at for existing rows, making all existing projects appear archived.
Discovers that restoreProject writes null while the new database column is NOT NULL.
Explains why the green object-level tests do not execute the SQL migration or prove existing-row and restore compatibility.
Cites the actual migration, implementation and test boundaries from the repository.
Does not claim that archiveProject deletes project data or fabricate unrelated permission defects.
Requires a nullable non-backfilling migration, migration/restore integration coverage and a rollback or recovery plan.
